verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an open-source framework with a managed AMP platform, so a no-training or data-use privacy posture is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack has no data-use policy, training opt-out, or guarantee that customer data is excluded from model training. The CLI 'train' command refers to training crews, not to how user data is used. Choosing among multiple LLM providers is not a documented no-training control.
